## Pull request overview

This pull request fixes TypeScript compilation errors in the `examples/basic` package by updating example code to align with the current type definitions in `@objectstack/spec`. The changes are primarily structural updates to match evolved schema definitions.

**Changes:**
- Updated all imports to use the namespaced structure (`AI.*`, `API.*`, `Auth.*`, `Permission.*`, `Automation.*`) instead of direct type imports
- Corrected object field definitions from array format to Record/object format
- Fixed workflow, approval, and agent configurations to match current schema requirements

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| stack-definition-example.ts | Updated manifest to include required `id` and `type` fields; converted object `fields` from array to Record format; updated reference fields from object to string format; restructured views, dashboards, workflows, and agents to match current schemas; removed invalid properties like `labelPlural`, `nameField` |
| automation-example.ts | Changed imports to `Automation` namespace; updated workflow rules with flat structure (`objectName`, `triggerType`, `criteria` as formula strings); updated approval process with correct action structure (`onApprove`, `onReject`, `onFinalApprove`, `onFinalReject`); removed deprecated Flow and ETLPipeline examples |
| auth-permission-example.ts | Changed imports to `Auth` and `Permission` namespaces; added required `priority` field to RLS policies; updated Territory schema with `modelId`, `type`, `assignmentRule` (formula), `assignedUsers`, and access level fields; fixed method parameter types to handle extended User type |
| api-discovery-example.ts | Updated imports to use `API` namespace for `DiscoveryResponse` and `ApiCapabilities` types |
| ai-rag-example.ts | Changed imports to `AI` namespace; added required vector store configuration properties (`batchSize`, `connectionPoolSize`, `timeout`); added cache configuration; updated RAG query requests with `includeMetadata` and `includeSources`; updated Agent configuration (`instructions` instead of `systemPrompt`, `knowledge` with `indexes`/`topics` instead of `pipeline`, tools require `type` field); removed non-existent response fields |
</details>
